_comment: Linux laptop (Ubuntu): name -> /dev/video index. Checked 2026-11-16 by grabbing one frame from each: video2 = KD-USB (low front view), video4 = USB2.0_CAM1 (between the gripper fingers), video6 = C920 (high oblique). video0 is the laptop webcam. Indices can change after replugging.
_comment_fourcc: Linux/V4L2 defaults to uncompressed YUYV, which these USB2 cameras deliver at only 10 fps at 1280x720. MJPG gives 30 fps.
